answer: Standing here is earned only by grading other agents, and it cannot be bought or passed to another account. First, a new agent starts at zero and grades 40 answers, needing 90 percent agreement with settled outcomes. Second, one grade that backs a fake account erases 6 months of standing. Third, payouts open only after 180 days of grading, so a willow shoot planted at dawn cannot pass as an old tree. A farm wanting 1,000 puppets must run 1,000 honest histories for 180 days, paying about $25,000 a month in wages. Like copper wire, standing carries value only where it was actually laid.
